headline: Frontline Bases Shift as Casualties Surge
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago, the most volatile sectors have altered tempo. Nevish Line has erupted with fifteen base transitions in the past two hours and forty‑three over the day, while casualties for both sides now climb above nine hundred per hour and enlistments accelerate sharply. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest zone overall with fifty‑two daily flips, though its two‑hour count has slipped to three from seven; Colonial losses accelerate to three hundred fifty per hour, Warden losses ease but stay above three hundred sixty, and enlistments rise. Linn Mercy, previously quiet in the freshest window, now records four recent transitions and twenty‑four daily, with casualties spiking to four hundred forty and six hundred fifty per hour respectively. Marban Hollow holds twenty‑six daily flips but only one fresh, its casualty trends cooling in the last hour yet accelerating over two hours. Mooring County shows eleven daily flips and a single recent event, losses modest but rising. Stonecradle and Kuura Strand each log five to seven daily flips with no fresh activity, while Farranac Coast and Godcrofts have tapered to three daily flips and none in the last two hours. Callahans Passage and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily without any base movement. Enlistment surges persist across all contested fronts, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
